scope: Independent mathematical and literal-source review of HTW1–HTW8 after correcting the tame simple-reflection relation and spelling out the Jacquet quotient and conditional local comparison. HTW9–HTW24 are outside this focused review.
findings: HTW1 uses the exact ell-primary diagonal quotient and shows the norm is an isomorphism from coinvariants to invariants for projective group-algebra modules by a regular-module calculation and direct summands. No division by its order is used, and the kernel is generated by the designated diagonal generators.

HTW2 now retains the diagonal-unit terms in the tame quadratic Hecke relation. The two displayed inverses follow with the stated multiplication order; the scalar (Q−1) relation is restricted to ordinary Iwahori invariants. Fundamental translation times the rotation permutation normalizes the full I_C including its diagonal residue condition. Dominant factorization and cancellation supply the literal torus action at both levels. The trace is the unnormalized finite norm, so its kernel and intertwining normalization are correct.

HTW3 injects I_C-fixed vectors into the actual Jacquet quotient by contraction, the subgroup-difference span, compact averaging and invertibility. Finite length gives a smooth torus character quotient before Frobenius reciprocity; a functional is not incorrectly assumed to detect the original eigenvector. The geometric-lemma filtration has n! one-dimensional factors, and exact Jacquet coinvariants give the claimed dimension bound. Triangularization and finite isotypic-sum averaging preserve the single exponent n!.

HTW4 uses the kernel filtration of N to show that the raw and exponential-corrected Weil matrices have the same characteristic polynomial. The full IsFrobSS condition preserves it. In the specified pro-ell tame kernel, a positive power lies in the monodromy open subgroup and acts trivially; finite order plus unipotent characteristic polynomial forces identity in characteristic zero.

HTW5 is valid without assuming local semisimplicity of R. The exact characteristic-polynomial identity makes each character trivial on every element killed by R, hence beta_i^(Q−1)=1. The finite nilpotent logarithm of T^(Q−1) obeys P^-1 L P=Q L; the ordered-pair nonresonance condition kills every entry, including diagonals. Vandermonde traces at f^a t then give the exact ordered matrix relation.

HTW6 retains all C containing ellC, every admissible Theta, every occurring joint generalized character, and every local correspondence in the antecedent. The half-modulus is |z|^((n−1)/2−i), so after algNorm the geometric Frobenius values are exactly Q^i chi(e_i(x)); the tame values have no Q factor. GUA2 or GUA12 proves Gd before conditional WDT is used. The tame-kernel calculation yields the actual matrix relation, not just its semisimplification. Uniformizer and tame generator are chosen before all ranks and classical points.

HTW7 descends vanishing of the n!-th power through the exact vector-separating classical family, using additive scalar-semilinear intertwining of finite double-coset operators. It does not replace vector separation by mere separation of the Hecke algebra.

HTW8 specializes the full determinant law over the polynomial scalar algebra, so both trace-polynomial identities have the exact group-algebra order. It first uses the one-place factor F_j, then commutation with other places; the exponent stays n! rather than growing with the number of auxiliary places. Rank zero and empty products are addressed without inverting n!.
corrections_resolved: The ordinary Iwahori scalar quadratic relation was replaced at tame level by its diagonal-unit relation, with explicit left and right inverses.
The Jacquet injection now includes the subgroup-difference averaging argument, and character quotient extraction precedes the induction adjunction.
The full C/Theta/chi quantifiers and the Gd guard before WDT-to-IsWDOf are explicit.
limitations: The exact three original LocPAlt foundations, full IsRecT laws and original local tame/Artin structure retain their stated status.
No Lean replay and no certification of later HTW claims by this focused report.
